packetProcedure: Freeze the actual assembled candidate and record its entry/runtime/configuration/asset hashes before exporting; do not substitute historical manuscripts or task-export lists.

Inventory learner-visible DOM plus native runtime task generation paths. Map every actual task/form/variant to stable native identity, route, renderer/template, instantiated prompt/givens/options, source and support locator. Report inventories per category and unresolved variants explicitly.

Traverse nested wrappers recursively to collect complete prompts, shared instructions, diagrams, data tables and prerequisite material. Do not drop a details wrapper merely because it also contains feedback.

Export source-grounded CH14 prerequisite passages and actual figures for cumulative demands. Assert prerequisite exports are nonempty, source-located and hash-bound to the specific CH14 source/candidate used; source presence is not teacher acceptance.

Attach every referenced figure and required context asset. Record attachment paths, bytes, SHA256, counts and original locators; assert all references resolve and nonempty assets are actually attached. Generated visual variants require an explicit instance mapping.

Run packet integrity before masking: reconcile every inventoried task with exactly its exported form, preserve complete prompts/givens/options/order, verify prerequisite and figure counts/hashes, and flag missing/ambiguous context rather than fabricate it.

After integrity passes, mask only feedback, solution/model-answer material and keys in the fresh-attempt copy. Compare prompt/given/option/figure signatures before and after masking to prove no task was removed or altered.
Keep keys/feedback and source-support mappings in a separate reviewer packet. Fresh attempts must be recorded before that material is opened, against the exact stable packet hash.

Record independent learner/source findings, unresolved protected decisions, actual runtime checks and Dean acceptance separately. Any candidate edit invalidates affected packet/review evidence and requires a new hash-bound version.
